name: timbre
description: One search across free music. Nothing stored, nothing hosted.

scripts._comment_dev_ytmusic: free-port first: uvicorn --reload leaves an orphaned worker on 8787 when its parent dies, and the orphan serves stale code while the new run silently loses the bind — docs/BUGS.md B-7.
scripts.dev:ytmusic: node scripts/free-port.mts 8787 && dotenv -e .env -- apps/ytmusic/.venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8787 --app-dir apps/ytmusic
scripts.dev:ytmusic:posix: node scripts/free-port.mts 8787 && dotenv -e .env -- apps/ytmusic/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8787 --app-dir apps/ytmusic
scripts._comment_typecheck: scripts/ is not a workspace, so -r would miss it; tsc -p scripts checks the release and hook scripts that Node otherwise runs unchecked.
scripts._comment_test: The scripts tests are not in a workspace, so -r would miss them — and scripts/release.mts is what chooses version numbers unattended.

_comment_engines: 22.18 rather than 22: scripts/ is TypeScript that Node runs directly, and that is the first 22.x where type stripping is on without a flag.
